hero.title: Durable memory. WhatsApp. Faster starts.
hero.lede: Version 0.10.0 adds broker-owned provider storage, on-demand durable chat memory, a signed WhatsApp transport, generated-image replies, and a deep hardening pass across every hot path.

highlights.title: Let an agent recall a delivered conversation after restart.
highlights.body: The broker now owns namespace-bound provider storage, and the optional memory provider exposes explicit recall instead of silently filling every prompt.
points: Transactional JSONL and durable-file interfaces with strict quotas
memory recent and memory search commands under fresh authorization
No automatic replay, cross-agent sharing, or secret path access

highlights.title: Reach the agent in more places without moving broker authority.
highlights.body: The gateway can accept signed WhatsApp webhooks and return bounded generated PNGs on supported chat routes.
points: Exact raw-body HMAC before WhatsApp payload parsing
Route-scoped OpenAI image generation with one bounded PNG
Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, and local development transports

highlights.title: Start faster and fail with a cause you can investigate.
highlights.body: A workspace-wide review removed redundant work, bounded more failure paths, and made broker outcomes easier to diagnose without leaking payloads.
points: Parallel provider compilation and optional persistent compile cache
One authorization pass and one audit serialization per invocation
Every broker failure carries a diagnosable cause

changes.title: Components can persist data without seeing a host path.
changes.body: The broker links an exact JSONL or durable-files interface to one authorized invocation. Namespace, scope, quotas, transaction boundaries, and physical layout remain native-host concerns.

changes.title: Recall is explicit, scoped, and on demand.
changes.body: After a complete chat-service or local-kernel acceptance, the gateway can submit one dedicated record request. Later, an authorized agent may run memory recent or memory search; stored text is never inserted automatically.

changes.title: A public webhook wakes the gateway, not the broker.
changes.body: The text-only transport verifies an exact HMAC over bounded raw bytes, deduplicates message IDs in bounded process memory, and derives canonical WhatsApp subjects before routing.

changes.title: One configured route can return one bounded PNG.
changes.body: The gateway fixes the OpenAI Images endpoint and authenticated reply target. Generated bytes never enter conversation memory, provider JSON, broker protocol, telemetry payloads, evidence, or audit.

changes.title: Compile once, reuse safely, and stop repeating work.
changes.body: Providers compile in parallel, linked imports become cached instance templates, and an optional disk cache survives process restarts. Every call still receives a fresh bounded store and component instance.

changes.title: Install the release through the channel that fits.
changes.body: All 23 public crates publish at 0.10.0. Chart 0.2.0 is published to GHCR with appVersion 0.10.0, beside attested archives, Homebrew, and the multi-architecture image.

telemetry.title: authority moved to the gateway or model
telemetry.body: Storage, WhatsApp, images, and faster provider loading add useful surfaces without making a proposal into permission. Cedar, execution constraints, provider credentials, and effect execution stay with the broker.
telemetry.note: The current one-pod deployment still shares one Unix UID trust domain. Dekopon remains pre-production.

packages.name: Homebrew
packages.body: After tapping and trusting dekopon-agents/tap, install all four executables and the example provider.

packages.name: crates.io
packages.body: Version 0.10.0 publishes every public workspace crate through crates.io trusted publishing.

packages.name: Container
packages.body: Use one distroless multi-architecture image for the broker, gateway, runner, or operator CLI.

current: Broker-owned provider storage with strict namespace, transaction, and quota boundaries
Optional durable chat memory queried explicitly with memory recent or memory search
Slack, Discord, Telegram, text-only WhatsApp, and local development transports
Route-scoped generated PNG replies on supported transports
Parallel and persistently cacheable provider compilation with fresh stores per call
Chart 0.2.0 deploying application v0.10.0 by default
next: A dedicated gateway UID and transport that turns attribution into process isolation
Independent retention or signing of audit checkpoints
Operator-CLI integration with the broker and gateway
Memory deletion and export workflows beyond on-demand recall
Further production hardening and incident-response automation
